label: v53.50
changes: Navigator now launches from the last verified workshop bundle first instead of waiting on the server every time
The app silently refreshes the verified bundle in the background for the next open
Service-worker caching is now cache-first for the shell, workshop scripts and essential remote Navigator modules
Old verified private bundles are retained as recovery copies instead of being aggressively deleted during updates
A new stability layer preserves DONE actions on the device if the connection drops and automatically syncs them when connectivity returns
First-time sign-in on a brand-new device still requires one successful server connection; after that the device has a resilient local workshop copy
Preserved all existing shared DONE states, assignments, project work register, Big Jobs and the 42.5 mm printable miter template
